rules.title: Rockville ban on algorithmic devices and shared competitor information in rent-setting
rules.requirement: Prohibits landlords from using algorithmic devices and shared competitor information to set rent, fees, or other rental terms.

coverage.summary: The source states no limits on which buildings or landlords are covered. It describes the ban as applying to landlords generally.

rules.effective_date_note: The effective date of January 1, 2027 comes only from the law-firm alert's table: "Rockville City Code § 18-148 (effective January 1, 2027)". As of the query date (2026-10-01) the ordinance is not yet effective.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using algorithmic devices and shared competitor information to set rent, fees, or other rental terms.
rules.review_note: The only source is a secondary law-firm alert (Morgan Lewis, Aug. 21, 2026). The ordinance text, ordinance number, enactment date, definitions, penalties and any exemptions were not captured. The effective date and scope should be checked against the official Rockville City Code § 18-148. The chapter-level alias is inferred from the section numbering.
rules.source_notes: The secondary source summarizes the provision in a table row. No official document was provided.
